lines.text: And somewhere between five tools, the story gets lost.
Helpin keeps the whole story in one place.
Support, projects, CRM, meetings and docs. One history, shared with your AI agents.
A customer writes in. Echo answers from your docs and past conversations.
If it's a bug, Echo hands it to your team, with everything it found.
It becomes a task, linked to the conversation.
Forge prepares the fix. Lens reviews it. You approve.
When it ships, Quill drafts the docs update, and Echo tells the customer, in the same conversation.
Before a call, Ask Agent catches you up, with sources.
You decide what each agent can do, and what needs your approval.
Helpin is open source. Self-host it for free, or run it on Helpin Cloud.
